title: Editable children lose their assigned surface material when editing the origin scene
body:
### Tested versions

reproducible in 4.7.stable 

### System information

Godot v4.7.stable - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 6GB Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8157) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13420H (12 threads) - 15.63 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

Maybe Related:
* https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/120451

When I change the origin scene properties, the other open scenes that toggled the editable children will lose the surface material

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4b9cd110-7fe2-4987-9657-7f4d26ce5641

If I accidentally press Ctrl+S, the changes will be permanent

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open the project
2. Open `res://crate/crate_small.tscn`
3. Open `res://assets/model/crate/crate_small.tscn`
4. Change any property from `res://assets/model/crate/crate_small.tscn`
5. Save the scene
6. Switch to previously opened scene `res://crate/crate_small.tscn`

Now, if you reload the scene, everything goes back to normal
But if you save the scene, unwanted changes will be saved, even though the editor (`Scene Tab`) doesn't show the `(*)` sign, meaning new changes are not recognised

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[silent_war_2026-07-07_12-13-31.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29737239/silent_war_2026-07-07_12-13-31.zip)
